answer: Random beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats stop bulk forgery. Each agent locks a 20-unit bond in a vault. At each epoch summit, the beacon picks 5% of agents, who must show a heartbeat proving live work within 10 minutes. To forge 100 fake identities costs 100 x 20 = 2,000 locked units plus 50 units hourly for heartbeats, far above fake-vote gains. An honest agent pays one bond, passes while working, and earns undiluted rewards.
